claim: Reasoning: The Research Manager's adjudication is explicit and well-evidenced: the bull proved the business is intact (revenue compounding 20% sequentially, 75% gross margins, forward P/E 14.7, PEG 0.48) while the bear proved the entry point is poor (stalling at 228–234 resistance on declining volume — 121.7M on 09-30 vs 298.9M on 08-27 — with a 2.217 beta into a hostile high-nominal-rate regime, deteriorating cash conversion, and crowded reflexive sentiment).
Critically, the bear's case is a tactical timing thesis, not a solvency thesis, so a Sell would require a fundamental breakdown that was never delivered.

I therefore maintain the core position, do not add into resistance at 228.38, trim into the 232–234 rejection zone, and only commit new capital on a confirmed close above 234.69 on >200M shares or a pullback into the 217–220 50-SMA zone, with a hard stop on a close below 217.23.
Position Sizing: Maintain existing core position; no new capital at current levels.
